name: altorank
description: Open-source SEO content software. Check whether search engines and AI crawlers can read a site, research keywords, read Google Search Console, and write sourced SEO drafts into a person's review queue. There is no approve or publish tool.

examples.title: Readiness check
examples.description: Run the nine readiness checks on a domain
examples.prompt: Check whether AI assistants can read example.com and tell me what is failing.

examples.title: Keyword ideas
examples.prompt: Suggest keywords my buyers search for, based on my site.

examples.title: Draft an article
examples.description: Write a sourced draft into the review queue
examples.prompt: Write a draft for the top keyword in my content plan.
